title: Dongcheng DCJZ2050 & DCJZ2050i Cordless Drill Driver, 20V, Brushless Motor, 50Nm Torque, 13mm Chuck, 2-Speed, 20+1/20+2 Torque Setting, Compact Design, Solo/4.0Ah Battery
description: Experience powerful performance and convenience with the Dongcheng DCJZ2050 & DCJZ2050i Cordless Drill Driver. Built with a high-efficiency brushless motor, this tool delivers up to 50N·m torque, making it ideal for heavy-duty applications. Its ultra-compact and ergonomic design ensures comfortable handling, even during extended use.The drill features 20+1 (DCJZ2050) / 20+2 (DCJZ2050i) torque settings, allowing precise control for a variety of tasks. With a high-strength 13mm keyless chuck, it ensures secure bit retention and easy bit changes.Enjoy versatility with 2-speed settings (0-600/2000 RPM for DCJZ2050, 0-550/1800 RPM for DCJZ2050i) and an impact function (DCJZ2050i only) for drilling into brick walls, steel, and wood (Max dia: Wood – 32mm, Steel – 13mm, Brick – 13mm).Powered by a 20V/4.0Ah lithium battery (optional solo version available), it's the perfect tool for professional and DIY users.Whether you’re drilling, driving, or tackling impact jobs, the Dongcheng DCJZ2050 series offers reliable, efficient, and portable performance in every use.
